steps.title: Prepare Matrigel‑coated plates
steps.instruction: Coat each required plate (6‑well, 96‑well, 24‑well, T25, chamber slide) with the indicated volume of Matrigel supplemented with RGD fragment, incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour (6‑well: 1 mL per well; 96‑well: 50 µL per well; 24‑well: 250‑300 µL per well; T25/flask: enough to cover surface).

steps.title: Split cells for nucleofection
steps.instruction: 48 h before nucleofection split confluent iPSC into 3 wells of a 6‑well plate (aim for 3 × 10⁶ cells total; 3‑6 confluent wells are sufficient).

steps.title: Wash and detach cells
steps.instruction: For each well to be nucleofected, wash with 1‑2 mL PBS, add 1 mL Accutase, incubate at 37 °C for 5‑10 min (check at 5 min) until single cells are obtained.

steps.title: Collect and spin cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells in 5 mL DMEM/F12, transfer to a 15 mL conical tube, spin at 750‑800 rpm for 3 min, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cells for plating
steps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in mTesR1 (2 mL per well) supplemented with 1 µM Rock Inhibitor, then plate 2 mL per well onto Matrigel‑RGD‑coated plates.

steps.title: Equilibrate nucleofection plates
steps.instruction: Immediately before nucleofection, add 3‑5 mL per well of DMEM/F12 + 10 % FBS + 10 µM Rock Inhibitor to the Matrigel‑RGD‑coated wells and let equilibrate.

steps.title: Aliquot DNA for nucleofection
steps.instruction: Aliquot the required DNA components (e.g., pMaxGFP 1 µg/µL, Cas9 SM168 3 µg total, donor oligo 100 µM, 300 µM final) into 1.7 mL tubes according to the provided table.

steps.title: Count cells and calculate volume
steps.instruction: Repeat wash/Accutase/detach steps, collect cells in 5 mL PBS, spin, resuspend pellet in 3 mL PBS, take 10 µL for counting on a Countess slide, calculate average cell number from four corners, multiply by 10 000 × 3 to obtain total cells, determine volume containing 3 × 10⁶ cells, then divide by 3 to get the volume needed per nucleofection.

steps.title: Prepare nucleofection reaction mix
steps.instruction: Using the Lonza P3 Primary Cell 4D kit (V4XP‑3024), prepare 100 µL reaction mix per nucleofection, combine with the aliquoted DNA from step 7.

steps.title: Mix cells with nucleofection reagents
steps.instruction: Add the cell pellet (from step 5) to the 100 µL reaction mix/DNA, pipette up‑and‑down with a P200 tip minimally until mixed.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the 100 µL cell/DNA suspension to a nucleofection cuvette, add a small amount of media via dropper to recover all cells, then electroporate using the 4D‑Nucleofector program for iPSC.

steps.title: Plate nucleofected cells
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer the electroporated cells into a pre‑coated well containing 2 mL DMEM/F12 + 10 % FBS + 10 µM Rock Inhibitor and incubate at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Post‑nucleofection culture
steps.instruction: Continue culturing the iPSC in one well of a 6‑well plate for 5‑7 days, changing mTesR1 daily. Add Rock Inhibitor as follows: 24 h post‑nucleofection add 5 µM, 48 h add 2.5 µM, 72 h add 1 µM.

steps.title: Plate dilutions for clone isolation
steps.instruction: Coat three wells of a 6‑well plate with 1 mL Matrigel‑RGD, wash, add 1 mL Accutase, incubate 37 °C 10 min, collect cells in 5 mL DMEM/F12, spin, resuspend in mTesR1 + 5 µM Rock Inhibitor, then plate serial dilutions (25 µL, 50 µL, 75 µL) in 2 mL mTesR1 per well.

steps.title: Freeze remaining cells after dilution
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 2× iPSC Freezing Media (20 % DMSO in FBS) to the leftover cells, mix gently, and incubate at 37 °C overnight before freezing.

steps.title: Pick individual clones into 96‑well plates
steps.instruction: Coat a 96‑well plate with 50 µL Matrigel per well, incubate 37 °C 1 h, aspirate Matrigel, add 50 µL mTesR1 + 10 µM Rock Inhibitor, then using a P20 tip pick each visible clone into a unique well (new tip per clone) and incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 96‑well plates for gDNA extraction (culture continuation)
steps.instruction: Coat a new 96‑well plate with 50 µL Matrigel per well, incubate 37 °C 1 h, aspirate Matrigel, add 50 µL mTesR1 + 10 µM Rock Inhibitor to appropriate wells, wash with 200 µL PBS, add 25 µL 0.05 % Trypsin, incubate 37 °C 5 min, verify detachment, add 50 µL FBS, mix, transfer 50 µL to a 96‑well PCR plate (for gDNA) and the remaining ~30 µL to a fresh 96‑well culture plate with mTesR1. Change media daily after 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare 96‑well plates for gDNA extraction (freezing)
steps.instruction: Wash wells with 200 µL PBS, add 25 µL 0.05 % Trypsin, incubate 37 °C 5 min, verify detachment, add 45 µL mTesR1, mix, transfer 15 µL to a 96‑well PCR plate (for gDNA), add 50 µL 2× Freezing Media (20 % DMSO in FBS) to the remaining cells, mix, wrap plate in parafilm, tape, label, place in a Styrofoam box with filler, and store at –80 °C up to 4 months.

steps.title: Extract gDNA from 96‑well PCR plates
steps.instruction: Spin PCR plates at 3800 rpm for 30 min at 4 °C. If cell pellets are not visible, transfer supernatant to a new plate and store at –20 °C. Add 50 µL QuickExtract DNA Solution to each pellet, vortex 15 s, incubate 65 °C 6 min, vortex 15 s, incubate 98 °C 2 min, then store at –20 °C until use.

steps.title: Set up PCR screening
steps.instruction: Using the extracted gDNA, set up PCR reactions (TouchDown protocol, 50 µL total) with primers specific for each cell line/mutation (design to amplify ~300‑400 bp). Include positive and negative controls.

steps.title: Run PCR products on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 % agarose gel: combine agarose with TBE, microwave until dissolved, add appropriate amount of Ethidium Bromide, pour into casting tray with combs, place in gel rig, run at 150 V for 90 min (check at 60 min).

steps.title: Image gel
steps.instruction: After electrophoresis, remove gel, place in Syngene imager, center the gel, capture multiple images and save them.

steps.title: Analyze gel and select clones
steps.instruction: Analyze banding patterns to identify potentially edited clones; if no restriction sites are created/destroyed, perform a T7 assay instead.

steps.title: Perform restriction digest (if applicable)
steps.instruction: Identify the appropriate restriction enzyme for the mutation, add enzyme to PCR product, incubate in a thermocycler at the enzyme’s optimal temperature (e.g., 37 °C, 42 °C, 25 °C) for 2‑3 h.

steps.title: Prepare samples for sequencing
steps.instruction: After confirming correct PCR product size, set up sequencing reactions: use Eurofins pre‑labeled tubes, place forward primer in one tube and reverse primer in another for each sample, document barcode numbers and tube positions, then ship.

steps.title: Thaw and re‑plate clones in 24‑well plates
steps.instruction: Coat a 24‑well plate with 250‑300 µL Matrigel per well, incubate 37 °C 1 h. Remove frozen 96‑well plate from –80 °C, thaw at 37 °C for 15‑20 min (check to avoid over‑thawing), transfer desired cells to 1.7 mL tubes, spin to remove freezing media, dilute 1:5 (final 500 µL) in mTesR1, plate in the 24‑well plate, and incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 24‑well plates for further culture
steps.instruction: Coat another 24‑well plate with 250‑300 µL Matrigel per well, incubate 37 °C 1 h, wash with 200‑500 µL PBS, add 25 µL 0.05 % trypsin, incubate 37 °C 5 min, during incubation add 400 µL mTesR1 + 10 µM Rock Inhibitor to each well of the coated plate, add 75 µL complete media (DMEM/F12 + 10 % FBS) to the trypsinized cells, mix, transfer cells to the prepared plate containing mTesR1 + Rock Inhibitor, and incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Freeze bulk iPSC stocks
steps.instruction: Add Accutase (Gibco A11105‑01) directly to cells, incubate 37 °C 3‑4 min, add DMEM/F12, gently scrape any remaining attached cells, collect all cells in a conical tube, add 2‑5 mL DMEM/F12 to rinse dish, centrifuge at 750 rpm 3 min RT, leave 0.5‑1 mL supernatant to avoid aspirating pellet, resuspend pellet in mTesR1 (no Rock Inhibitor), add an equal volume of cold 2× Freezing Media (20 % DMSO in FBS) (e.g., for 1 mL total volume add 0.5 mL mTesR1 and 0.5 mL freezing media), pipet once, aliquot 1 mL per pre‑labeled cryovial, label clearly, freeze at –80 °C in foam racks for 48‑72 h, then transfer to liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Prepare samples for karyotype, RNA, ICC
steps.instruction: From a confluent 6‑well plate, collect cells: for karyotype, add 2 mL mTesR1 to 2‑well cell suspension; for gDNA pellet, place 500 µL cells in a 1.7 mL tube, spin max speed 15 s, aspirate media, store at –80 °C; for RNA pellet, place 900 µL cells in a 1.7 mL tube, spin max speed 15 s, aspirate, store at –80 °C; for ICC, dilute 100 µL cells in 750 µL mTesR1, plate 200 µL per well in 4 wells of a chamber slide.

steps.title: Prepare DNA component table
steps.instruction: Record DNA reagents: pMaxGFP at 1 µg/µL, use 1 µL (1 µg total); Cas9 SM168 at unspecified concentration, use volume to obtain 3 µg total; donor oligo at 100 µM, use 3 µL (300 µM final).
